note: The condition words of the game (kits/core/conditions.gd), written by: godot --headless --path . res://tests/conditions_test.tscn -- --seed=1 --write-words. The data checker reads it. Do not edit by hand.

after.note: At least n Time Quiz questions have passed since this story piece was read (after:<piece>:<n>).

animals.note: How many of this animal live on the farm now (its animal node).

arith_level.note: The Rest sums level: 1 + the bronze medals won.

chance.note: Holds with this chance (0 to 1), the same answer all through one question: asking does not use up luck.

chapter.note: The chapter now (1 + the pets home).

coins.note: Coins in the purse, in bronze.

done.note: This node (a goal, building, card …) is done.

empty_patches.note: Field patches in use with nothing planted now.

forest_poisoned.note: Times the farmer was poisoned by a wrong plant.

forest_trips.note: Walks into the forest so far.

item.note: How many of this item are in the store.

items_seen.note: Different things the farmer has had.

lord_owed.note: Bronze owed for the Lord's share now.

lord_paid.note: Bronze paid for the Lord's share so far.

open.note: This goal (or other node) can be started now: what it needs is there and it is not done yet.

packed.note: Different things in the bag now.

page.note: The page of this knowledge card has been opened.

rain.note: It rained in this question (in winter it snows instead).

rest_quick.note: Rest sums answered right and quickly so far.

season.note: It is this season now: spring, summer, autumn or winter.

seasons.note: How many seasons have passed since the start (0 in the first spring).

seen.note: This interface element has been shown, or this story piece read.

skill_ranks.note: Skill ranks reached, all families together.

sold_kinds.note: Different things sold at the market.

start.note: A new game, before the first question.

step.note: Time Quiz questions answered right (steps of farm time).

tap.note: This place (or patch:<kind>) has been tapped.

trips.note: Trips to the village so far.

water.note: Water the farmer has now (in the bucket and barrels).

weeds_max.note: The most weeds on one field patch in use now.

well_mood.note: How well the farmer feels, from 0 to 1.
